chapter_title: Concerning the Wheel that exists in front of the K

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
The teaching speaks again about the total ordering of the ultimate degree that stands openly before the Divine in the inmost height, as the primary containment and fastening of every subordinate governing principle in higher and lower regions under a hard restraint; for the whole determination of Divine rule is fixed there as the governing ultimate. Moreover, every hostile impulse and resisting intention arising within the heavens is gathered, confined, and held fast within that same restraint.

This ultimate ordering is in the brightness of manifest wisdom, arranged with harmonious form and the appearance of perfect order. Within it is fullness of organized discriminations that keep distinct each heaven and each governing power within it; and all of them are held within that discrimination, so that if any governing principle should attempt to withdraw from its appointed order, it is immediately constrained. If it should attempt to introduce a hidden perversion within its constraint, that perversion becomes evident at once within the ordering itself. All general knowledges in the outer degree, all distinct knowledges within them, and the chief directing influence among operative powers are present there and are made knowable by means of that ordering, in the Divine presence.

The fullness of discrimination within that ordering includes a sufficient complement of bright operative powers conjoined and mutually intertwined throughout the whole extension of the ultimate degree; and every state in which they are pressed into limitation, and every state in which they are given freedom of extension, is laid open by that ordering. For the first basis of all the heavens above and below, and of their governing principles, is held, fixed, and made immovable within it.

A perpetual attentive discernment is maintained directly before the Divine, so that a holy dread—rising from the Divine presence—seizes all composite and mixed operative forces and keeps their first principles fastened there, so that they cannot withdraw from the restraint that binds them into order.

In this respect the ultimate ordering is like an unbroken binding restraint before the protecting vigilance that guards Divine order; for whenever anything stirs toward disorder among those held within the restraint, the disturbance is immediately within that vigilance.

This is likewise the case for all governing principles in the heavens and for every operative force in the ultimate degree: if any should attempt to withdraw, it is at once identified and uncovered by that ordering. For this ordering is as an all-disclosing faculty of discernment, because the power to distinguish and reveal every quality and tendency is present within it.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Highly coherent as a single spiritual teaching about the ultimate degree functioning as a divinely-present restraint and disclosure mechanism for subordinate powers. The only stumble is ¶5, which is syntactically broken in the source and requires contextual smoothing, but it still fits the chapter’s consistent voice and purpose.

findings.diagnosis: Clean, continuous correspondential teaching: the ‘wheel’ is explained by what it DOES (binds, discloses, stabilizes) and the narrative develops that function stepwise (containment → discrimination/visibility → internal operative linkage → continuous observation/fear → universal detectability). No seam markers or jurisdictional cataloging intrudes.
findings.evidence: Text is functional throughout: ¶1 ‘root of the rulers… in a… fetter… entire will… placed in it… enmity… gathered and ensnared’; ¶2 ‘twelve seals… between every firmament… should one… wish to escape, he will be bound… trick… apparent’; ¶3 ‘five shining men… conjoined and enmeshed… every place… cramped… have space, is displayed’; ¶4 ‘observation… so that fear… will assume… hold their root affixed’; ¶6 ‘wheel is like a great mirror, for the discrimination of all things.’ The spiritual reading reports ‘Highly coherent as a single spiritual teaching…’ and does not flag any narrative break here; its paraphrase arises naturally from the wheel’s disclosed functions (binding/revealing).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty due to textual damage/fragmentation, not an insertion. The analogy (‘chain… chief guard’) continues the same functional argument (surveillance-by-restraint), but the clause that should specify the detection mechanism is broken, forcing reconstruction. The reader’s only stumble is syntactic, matching a lacuna rather than a voice shift.
findings.evidence: Coptic text is visibly corrupt: ‘for when [anything moves] in th[ose who are guarded] in the [chain]in.’ This is exactly where the spiritual reading notes: ‘The paragraph is fragmentary in the source, so the motion clause is reconstructed from context.’ Importantly, the imagery matches the chapter’s functional teaching (restraint that immediately shows movement), and there is no administrative marker (no territorial jurisdictions, named officers list, ranked inventory). Removing ¶5 would not “repair” a seam; it would simply delete an explanatory analogy that ¶6 resumes (‘This is likewise the case…’).

textual_criticism.summary: 2 findings: (1) ¶1-4,6 confirmed as a coherent correspondential substrate teaching with no insertion signals; (2) ¶5 diagnosed as genuine difficulty from textual damage (broken syntax), not an administrative overlay. Excision: 0. Annotation: 0. None: 2.

harmonized_paragraphs.text:
⟨p.88⟩
[Agai]n the [teaching] speaks about the wheel that exists in front [of the King of Honour who dwells in] the seventh firmament [there], the root of the rulers above and below in a great and cruel fetter; as the entire will of the great King of Honour is placed in [it]. Also, their entire enmity, which is in the firmaments, is [gathered] and ensnared in it.

It exists in a blaze of splendour [with] ornamentation and great beauty. Now, there are twelve seals in it. The seal between i[s] every firmament and the rulers who are there [which bind them] are in it; for should one of them wish to escape, he will be bound [there]. If he should wish to cause a trick in his bond [it will be] apparent and known in [that] wheel [itself]. The spheres and stars and [the] leader of all the powers exist there, and can be known by it, in front of the King of Honour.

The twelf[t]h seal that is in it is its five shining men that are conjoined and enmeshed through the entire zone; because every place where they are cramped, and every place where they have space, is displayed by that wheel. For the root of all the firmaments above and below, and that of their rulers, is ensnared and fixed in it.

The observation [of the wheel] is set right at all times opposite the great King o[f Honour in his place] so that fear, wh[ich is from him] will assume all the powers of mixture [and will hold] their root affixed there, so that they cannot make an esc[a]pe from the fetter of their bond.
That wheel rese[m]bles, in this respect, a chain in front of the chief guard, for when [anything moves] in th[ose who are guarded] in the [chain]in.

This is also the case for all the rulers who are in the firmaments, and every power of the zone: If they should wish to escape, they shall be recognised and revealed by that wheel. [As] the wheel is like a great mirror, for [the di]scrimination of all things [set] in it.

changes_summary: No changes made. Finding 1 (¶1–4, ¶6) recommends none; Finding 2 (¶5) recommends none (damage/fragmentation, not an insertion), and there were no excision recommendations to execute.
